title: Building Login & Logout UI
description: Use React hooks to show user info, login buttons, and a custom sign‑in page.

slides.title: The Session on the Client 👤
slides.content:
# `useSession` Hook

NextAuth provides a React hook to access the session state on the client.

```jsx
import { useSession } from 'next-auth/react';

const { data: session, status } = useSession();
```

* `status` can be `'loading'`, `'authenticated'`, `'unauthenticated'`.
* `session` contains user info (name, email, image) if authenticated.

No need to manually fetch user data!

quizData.question: What does `signIn()` do when called without arguments?

options.text: Signs in with a default provider
Redirects to the default sign‑in page

quizData.explanation: Calling `signIn()` without a provider ID takes the user to the generic sign‑in page where they can choose a provider.

slides.title: Custom Sign‑In Page 🎨
Custom Sign‑In Page (pages/auth/signin.js)
slides.content: A branded page with a GitHub login button.

quizData.question: How do you tell NextAuth.js to use your custom sign‑in page?

options.text: By setting the `pages.signIn` option in the NextAuth config
It's automatic if the file exists in `pages/auth/`

quizData.explanation: The `pages` option in `authOptions` allows overriding default NextAuth pages like signIn, signOut, error, etc.
